intro.texto: PRC AI 2.0. An artificial intelligence in the Windows terminal, on your own computer.
intro.oido: PRC-AI 2.0, an artificial intelligence in a Windows terminal on your own computer.

local.texto: The model, Gemma 4, runs on the laptop itself. No key, no cloud, and the conversation never leaves your computer.
local.oido: The model, Gemma 4, runs on the laptop itself. No key, no cloud, and the conversation never leaves your computer.

web.texto: When a question needs current data, it searches the internet, reads the pages and cites its sources.
web.oido: When a question needs current data, it searches the internet, reads the pages, and cites its sources.

equipo.texto: And what the computer already knows, like its free memory, it reads straight from Windows.
equipo.oido: and what the computer already knows, like it's free memory, it reads straight from Windows.

comandos.texto: You can ask for a new command just by chatting. Read-only: fixed rules check it, it tests it and saves it. From then on, it uses it when you ask.
comandos.oido: You can ask for a new command just by chatting. Read-only. Fixed rules check it. It tests it and saves it. From then on, it uses it when you ask.

consultas.texto: Web pages work the same way: it picks the page, pulls out the data you ask for, and shows it to you before saving.
consultas.oido: Web pages work the same way. It picks the page, pulls out the data you ask for, and shows it to you before saving.

preferencias.texto: It also remembers how you want it to answer, in this conversation and the next ones.
preferencias.oido: It also remembers how you want it to answer in this conversation and the next ones.

aprende.texto: And the newest part: it learns from your business folder. It reads Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF, and tells you what it can't read, like a scanned invoice.
aprende.oido: And the newest part, it learns from your business folder. It reads Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and PDF, and tells you what it can't read, like a scanned invoice.

pregunta.texto: You ask, and it answers with what your documents say, and which one it comes from: a whole carrot cake is 48 dollars, according to the PDF catalog. And if something isn't there, like an employee's pay, it doesn't make it up: it tells you it's not in the documents.
pregunta.oido: You ask, and it answers with what your documents say and which one it comes from. A whole carrot cake is $48, according to the PDF catalog. And if something isn't there, like an employee's pay, it doesn't make it up. It tells you it's not in the documents.

buscar.texto: With documents search you can see where each answer comes from, without asking the model. Here, the price table from the PDF.
buscar.oido: With document search, you can see where each answer comes from, without asking the model. Here, the price table from the PDF.

olvida.texto: It also forgets. Ask it to forget the extensions: it shows what it will forget and waits for your yes. Your files aren't touched, and in a new conversation that data is gone.
olvida.oido: It also forgets. Ask it to forget the extensions. It shows what it will forget and waits for your yes. Your files aren't touched. And in a new conversation, that data is gone.

recuerda.texto: And it can be undone: what was forgotten stays on a list, and restore brings it back.
recuerda.oido: and it can be undone. What Was Forgotten stays on a list, and Restore brings it back.

final.texto: PRC AI 2.0. It learns from your business documents, forgets what you ask it to, and if something isn't there, it tells you.
final.oido: PRCAI 2.0. It learns from your business documents, forgets what you ask it to, and if something isn't there, it tells you.
